issues.title: Broken External Symbol Resolution
issues.why: The spec references 'apperror' and 'pathutil' packages and specific error codes (AB-9301) which are defined in spec/03, but that context is not provided in this module.
issues.fix: Provide the normative Go package definitions for apperror and the error registry in the context or as a snippet.

issues.title: Ambiguous SQLite Transaction Type
issues.why: AC-SC-11 and AC-SC-21 mention 'BEGIN TRANSACTION' and 'BEGIN IMMEDIATE' but don't specify the SQLite locking mode required to prevent 'database is locked' errors during the lock-then-tx sequence.
issues.fix: Explicitly mandate 'BEGIN IMMEDIATE' for all seeder write transactions to ensure exclusive access.
